verdict.rationale: Ubuntu Desktop is an operating system, not an agent, so an official MCP server for connecting agents is a fair capability to ask about and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server, MCP endpoint, or any official agent-integration interface. Generic claims about running AI/ML tooling and the AT-SPI accessibility interfaces are host-platform features or developer building blocks, not an official MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
